distribution.summary: Anhui; Fujian; Guizhou; Hainan; Hong Kong; Jiangsu; Jiangxi; Shaanxi; Shanghai; Sichuan; Yunnan; Zhejiang; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984), Huang & Lu (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) document the reviewed Chinese distribution. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently documented Taiwan; their broad regional China wording is not converted to provinces. Lau (2025) provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong.

host_note: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) support the four historical hosts; Smith et al. (2020) reported Liquidambar at genus level. Beaver & Liu (2010) documented Cinnamomum camphora and Pinus spp. in Taiwan.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cnestus mutilatus (Blandford, 1894).

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) used Xyleborus mutilatus and 黄复生等 (2015) used Hadrodemius mutilatus. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cnestus mutilatus. The current canonical identity remains Cnestus mutilatus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_1122.
